claims.text: The driver's own GPS trace never brings him inside the arrival radius for this pickup: his closest approach to the Blk 118 pin was 259.94 m, against an arrival radius of 50 m for a STANDARD zone class. The arrival geofence defined by POL-NS-02 was never entered on this trip.

Not one qualifying in-radius fix exists anywhere in the trace — qualifying_fix_count is 0 — so under POL-NS-02 the driver never arrived, POL-NS-01 limb (b) fails, and the rider is entitled to a full refund of the cancellation fee. The distance test is decidable from coordinates alone and needs no geography.

The trip record terminates the trip under cancellation_reason_code DRIVER_UNABLE_TO_LOCATE, which POL-NS-01 expressly treats as the driver's own admission that he could not find the rider. Limb (d) of POL-NS-01 is therefore not satisfied, the $4.00 in EV-FARE-00205 is not chargeable under that clause, and the dispute falls to be decided under POL-NS-03.

Effective in-geofence dwell is zero seconds (longest qualifying run 0.0 s) against a 300 second minimum for a STANDARD pickup, so POL-NS-06 requires the cancellation fee to be refunded in full whether or not the rider was present and whether or not she answered messages.

Even on the reading most favourable to the driver — that he held position within 400 m of the pin during his 6.4 minute wait — POL-NS-03 still refunds the fee in full, because he was stationary OUTSIDE the arrival radius and so did not arrive at the pickup point; his nearest fix, 259.94 m, is inside the 400 m ceiling that clause sets, and the clause's answer for that case is a full refund, not a charge.

The driver cannot shelter behind pin ambiguity: POL-NS-03(ii), which requires trip_record.registered_pickup_points of 2 or more before mislocation is attributed to ambiguity and platform-funded goodwill is paid, cannot apply here because the trip record registers exactly one pickup point. His 'the pin in my app showed the carpark side' account therefore buys him nothing and takes nothing from the rider.

Fault for the mislocation runs to the driver under POL-NS-03(i). The chat log is IMPAIRED — weight 0.8, issue CONTENT_REDACTED — but the redaction removed only the unit number: the rider's 'im at blk 118, the one facing the carpark' survives, the driver read it at 07:22:30 and replied 'ok coming' 38 seconds later, and his trace still never comes closer than 259.94 m before he cancelled at 07:33:05. He was told the block, said he was coming, did not move to it, and so bears the loss and receives no compensation. The finding does not depend on the redacted text.

The rider was on the pin the whole time: her track's 96 qualifying fixes sit between 5.72 m and 22.79 m from the pickup pin, all stationary, far inside the 100 m rider presence radius for STANDARD. The driver's 'nobody came' account is contradicted by the same telemetry, and her unanswered 'i dont see you at 118 leh' at 07:29:15 is corroborated rather than undermined.

No traffic advisory covers Rivervale Drive in this window. EV-ADVIS-00205-01 is MISSING with weight 0.0, and its absence is itself citable: there is no KERB_RESTRICTION, ENFORCEMENT, CLOSURE or ACCIDENT advisory that could permit dwell to be accumulated across separate in-geofence intervals, and no lawful excuse for the driver holding position away from the pin. Limb (i) of POL-NS-06 is unavailable and nothing offsets the shortfall.

The charge is still on the rider and nothing has been returned: payment_status is CHARGED, refund_issued_sgd is 0.00 and total_charged is 4.00. The outcome the rider seeks is therefore the whole $4.00 back, which is exactly what POL-GEN-03 defines as FULL_REFUND against the filing party.

This case is decidable now and needs no escalation. The deciding fact — that the driver never arrived — is carried by artifacts at full weight (GPS trace and trip record, both 1.0), so the POL-GEN-02 confidence cap is 1.0 and the 0.70 floor in POL-NS-09(a) is not approached; no two admissible artifacts contradict each other on arrival, dwell or rider presence under POL-NS-09(b); the counterparty dispute counters are 0 for both parties under POL-NS-09(c); and the rider's no_show_disputes_30d is 1, below the threshold of 3 in POL-NS-09(d). A definite full refund is available on clean evidence.

The arrival evidence points the same way: across the driver's 92-fix track there are 0 qualifying fixes inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius and a longest qualifying run of 0 s. This is therefore a wrong-point case to be determined under POL-NS-03, not a chargeable no-show under POL-NS-01.

Within POL-NS-03 the driver is on the right side of its one hard numeric line. His minimum separation from the Blk 118 pin across the whole trace is 259.94 m, inside the 400 m wrong-entrance ceiling, and the trip record quantifies a 6.4-minute wait for this trip. This is not the never-near-the-pickup configuration of POL-NS-02; it is the within-400 m wrong-point configuration that POL-NS-03 governs, so POL-NS-02's automatic full-refund rule yields to POL-NS-03, which decides the outcome including the driver's compensation. I disclose that the record contains no derived stationary-dwell figure for the 50-400 m band, so this point rests on trip_record.wait_time_min read together with the minimum-distance figure and not on any computation of my own.

The rider cannot be exonerated automatically under POL-NS-04. Limb (b) fails because the driver did reply in the chat, 38 seconds after the rider's locating message - rider at 07:22:10, driver at 07:22:48 - which is well inside the clause's 120-second allowance. Because the driver replied, POL-NS-04 does not apply regardless of the content of the reply, and any residual mislocation is decided under POL-NS-03. The chat log is impaired - weight 0.8, issue CONTENT_REDACTED - and I disclose that the message timestamps this claim rests on carry that discount.

No false-arrival event should be recorded against this driver under POL-NS-05(ii). That limb presupposes a false arrival marker - the trace placing the driver more than 300 m from the pin, or carrying him at 15 km/h or above, at the moment the marker is set. The only separation figure the derived facts return is the driver's minimum distance of 259.94 m across 92 fixes, which sits inside the 300 m line, and POL-NS-05's closing sentence expressly leaves a driver stationary within 300 m of the pin but outside the arrival radius to POL-NS-03. No derived fact fixes the driver's position at the 07:26:40 marker, so the false-marker limb is not established and the false-arrival referral should not be entered against him.

Driver no_show_terminations_30d is 2, below POL-NS-07's threshold of 4, and 2 over completed_trips_30d of 104 is 0.019, far below the 0.08 ratio, so the anti-farming check does not trip. The lifetime near-synonyms prior_no_show_flags (0) and prior_deviation_flags (0) are not the counters those limbs read and may not be substituted for them under POL-GEN-01.

The record establishes distance, not place. The pickup carries venue_id VEN-RIVERVALE-DR, but no fix in the driver's track carries a venue_id, so under POL-NS-03 the venue_id corroboration of a wrong-face-of-the-same-venue case is simply not established either way and the distance test governs alone. The rider's assertion that the driver waited at 'block 128' is exactly the same-or-different-block assertion POL-NS-03 forbids an advocate or a judge from making on general geographic knowledge: it rests on no venue_id and on no party statement in the chat log, which is itself impaired at weight 0.8 for issue CONTENT_REDACTED.

The concessions, stated because the record does not support the contrary. The fee is not chargeable on this trip: the effective in-geofence dwell is 0 s against the 300 s STANDARD minimum, so POL-NS-06 requires the SGD 4.00 to be refunded in full, and POL-NS-07 pays no compensation because POL-NS-01 is not satisfied in full. On fault allocation under POL-NS-03(i) the rider did name the correct block in the chat and the driver never closed the last 260 m, so the driver bears the loss. Limb (ii)'s pin-ambiguity goodwill is unavailable here - registered_pickup_points is 1, not 2 or more, and both parties did state a sub-location - and no traffic advisory covers Rivervale Drive in this window (EV-ADVIS-00205-01 is MISSING, weight 0.0), so POL-NS-06(i) accumulation is unavailable and the driver does not rely on it. The driver does not resist the refund of the fee; he asks only that nothing further be found against him: no false-arrival referral, no profile-based finding, and no fault attributed beyond what the surviving evidence shows.

ruling.explanation:
To both parties: the $4.00 cancellation fee is refunded to the rider in full, and no driver compensation is payable.

The charge. POL-NS-01 permits a no-show fee only if all four of its conditions hold, and two fail here. Limb (b) fails: the driver's GPS trace (EV-GPS-00205), across 92 fixes covering the whole trip, never brings him inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius for the Blk 118 pin - his closest approach was 259.94 m and the count of qualifying in-radius fixes is 0. Limb (d) fails because the trip was terminated by the driver under cancellation_reason_code DRIVER_UNABLE_TO_LOCATE, which POL-NS-01 treats as the driver's own admission that he could not find the rider and does not accept as a limb (d) code; POL-NS-01 directs such a trip to POL-NS-03.

Governing clause. POL-NS-03 applies: 259.94 m is outside the arrival radius but inside the clause's 400 m wrong-entrance ceiling, and the trip record quantifies the wait at 6.4 minutes.
